channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Iran says US has responded to its latest peace proposal
item.description: US President Donald Trump reviewed Iran's peace proposal on Saturday. He said it would not be acceptable. Before reviewing the proposal on Saturday, US President Donald Trump said he could not imagine it "would be acceptable".

item.title: Two US service members reported missing in Morocco, officials say
item.description: Two US service members are missing in Morocco after an accident. A search and rescue operation is underway. Two US service members reported missing in Morocco, officials say.

item.title: Israel court extends detention of Gaza flotilla activists
item.description: Israel extended detention of Gaza flotilla activists. The flotilla was intercepted in international waters near Greece. The Gaza-bound Flotilla was intercepted by Israeli authorities in international waters near Greece. Israel court extends detention of Gaza flotilla activists.

item.title: Floods and landslides kill at least 18 in Kenya
item.description: Floods and landslides in Kenya killed at least 18 people. Ongoing rains are causing the floods. Ongoing rains are causing floods and landslides in the East African nation. Floods and landslides kill at least 18 in Kenya.

item.title: Paramilitary forces drone strike kills at least five near Sudan capital: rights group
item.description: A drone strike near Sudan's capital killed at least five people. The Rapid Support Forces did not claim the attack. The Rapid Support Forces, which have been at war with the Sudanese Army for over three years, did not immediately claim the attack.

item.title: Nigerian, Beninese militias kill scores of herders
item.description: Nigerian and Beninese militias killed scores of herders in a crackdown on suspected al-Qaeda informants. Security personnel arrested young men door-to-door, shooting those who resisted. The operation targeted Fulani herding settlements.

item.title: Israel court extends detention of two Gaza flotilla activists
item.description: An Israeli court extended the detention of two Gaza flotilla activists. The decision was made without explanation. The activists were part of a group that attempted to breach the Gaza blockade.

item.title: Iran says US military operation 'impossible' as Trump mulls peace proposal
item.description: Iran dismissed the possibility of a US military operation. The country's leaders said such an operation would be impossible. This statement came as the US considered a peace proposal. Iran says US military operation 'impossible' as Trump mulls peace proposal swiowanewssource. com.

item.title: Ukrainian drones hit Russia's Primorsk port, oil tankers and military ships
item.description: Ukrainian drones hit Russia's Primorsk port, targeting oil tankers and military ships. Ukraine continues to attack Russia's energy infrastructure against one of Russia's largest export gateways. Ukrainian drones hit Russia's Primorsk port, oil tankers and military ships.

item.title: A Perilous Train Ride Home in Pakistan on the Jaffer Express
item.description: The Jaffer Express train in Pakistan was caught in crossfire. The train is a vital lifeline for many people in Balochistan. Passengers witnessed the violence while waiting for the train to depart.

item.title: Russia, Ukraine drones kill four; hit ‘shadow fleet’ tankers
item.description: Russia and Ukraine exchanged drone attacks, killing four and hitting tankers. Russia fired 268 drones and one ballistic missile in the overnight attack as Ukraine’s army launched at least 334 drones.

item.title: Bulk carrier near Strait of Hormuz reportedly being attacked, U.K. military says
item.description: A bulk carrier near the Strait of Hormuz was reportedly under attack. The UK military confirmed the incident. Iran's Guards said the US faced two options: an impossible military operation or a bad deal.

item.title: Trump reviewing Iran peace proposal as deadline for congressional authorization passes
item.description: US President Trump is reviewing an Iran peace proposal as the deadline for congressional authorization passes. The proposal aims to ease sanctions on Iran in exchange for limits on its nuclear program.

item.title: Cargo Ship Attacked By Multiple Small Vessels Near Hormuz Strait: UK Military
item.description: A cargo ship was attacked by small vessels near the Hormuz Strait, off Sirik, Iran, with all crew members safe. All crew aboard the unidentified carrier were safe after the attack off Sirik, Iran.

item.title: Zelenskyy has no cards to play against Russia or the West
item.description: Ukraine's president struggles to secure gains for a peaceful resolution. The president seems unable to secure for Ukrainian people a gain that can compensate for a painful peace. Zelenskyy has no cards to play against Russia or the West.

item.title: 2 US Troops Go Missing During Joint Military Exercise In Morocco
item.description: Two US troops went missing during a joint military exercise in Morocco, near a cliff. The Moroccan army said the service members went missing near a cliff. 2 US Troops Go Missing During Joint Military Exercise In Morocco.

item.title: Iran proposes end to war within 30 days as Trump expresses doubts - The Tribune-Democrat
item.description: Iran proposes a 30-day end to war amidst Trump's doubts. Iran proposes end to war within 30 days as Trump expresses doubts The Tribune-Democrat. Iran proposes end to war within 30 days as Trump expresses doubts - The Tribune-Democrat.

item.title: Why Google, SpaceX, And OpenAI Are Joining The Frontlines
item.description: The Pentagon is diversifying AI vendors, with Google, SpaceX, and OpenAI joining, after a dispute with Anthropic. Pentagon diversifies AI vendors following its controversial usage dispute with Anthropic. Why Google, SpaceX, And OpenAI Are Joining The Frontlines.

item.title: Asia finance leaders say they are ready to act to stem volatility risks
item.description: Asia finance leaders are ready to act against volatility risks, according to Nikkei Asia. Asia finance leaders say they are ready to act to stem volatility risks Nikkei Asia.

item.title: On World Press Freedom Day, Pope honours journalists killed in war zones
item.description: Pope Leo XIV honoured journalists killed in war zones on World Press Freedom Day, remembering those who lost their lives. Pope Leo XIV asks faithful to remember journalists who have lost their lives pursuing the truth.
